upper_payload_definition: uint32_t upper_row, upper_off and upper_dat element payload only, same resident arrays in both ASI entry modes; excludes container metadata, allocator and original bottom index

fixture.trace_policy: Only first round serialized; ASI skips empty scope before serialization, NodeANN serializes returned=[]; repeated-round values only checked in aggregate.

limits: Known HNSW component control, not a new contribution or standalone paper.
Native topology is matched; ASI still adds MST/cross edges and uses shared DQS, NodeANN still searches each local bottom graph.
Finite greedy/beam navigation has no universal recall guarantee.
PQ exact overlap with FP32 GT is a reference, not a hard recall upper bound.
High-layer scoring and edge slots are charged to ASI query cost, including the starting entry score.
NodeANN slot counts are not instrumented; null is unmeasured, not zero.
No FP32 rerank, no new gateway mechanism, no scope-size switching.
WSL clock, CPU exclusivity and build-seed generalization are not controlled.
Fixture verifies scope, unique IDs, cache work and singleton; NodeANN returns different valid tied ID sets for duplicate-OR input, so no cross-method tie equivalence is claimed.
All main timed query scopes are nonempty. ASI empty scopes skip before timing accumulation; the empty fixture case is not a performance benchmark.
threshold_definition: abs(new/reference - 1) <= 0.02 is practically indifferent, not an exact equality or significance test; raw values and exact Pareto dominance are unchanged.
graph_normalization: json.dumps(per-concept native graph record, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma,colon)), UTF-8, SHA256. Full records also compared directly for exact equality before MST/cross edges.
reference_coverage: 1400 nonempty main-workload query/config pairs, comparing only fields present in the seed-aligned f5bb5f5 reference; not all control JSON keys and not a coverage claim for singleton owners. Singleton behavior is separately checked in the fixture.
threshold_source: Relative 2% practical indifference applied during analysis only; does not change runtime, raw measurements, exact correctness checks or Pareto dominance.
selection_policy: For each fixed target recall (taken from NodeANN N10/15/20), apply the same inclusive relative 2% band and full-output requirement to ALL methods; independently select each method's fastest measured point. Do not keep NodeANN at an unnecessarily slow reference setting while tuning Ours.
post_measurement_changes: ASI header comments and isolated render-entry action added after timing. Recompiled ASI binary SHA256 is identical to the timed binary; measurement function unchanged. Original timed source hashes remain in hashes.
exact_quality_band_test: With the same GT denominator: abs(candidate_fp_hits - target_fp_hits)*50 <= target_fp_hits. Inclusive boundary uses integer counts, not rounded recall.
